messages:
Alex (Support): FYI escalated account PineWave Health — ingestion failing for multi-file batches. Ticket SUP-5900 opened. Customer is 3 weeks from renewal; CSM Jess assigned.
Jess (CS): Appreciate the flag. Short answers: did this start after SDK update? Are they on our managed pipeline? I can lead immediate customer comms.
Alex (Support): Theyre on SDK v1.8.0. Error occurs when combined payload >12MB. Error sample: `504 Gateway Timeout POST /v1/batch_ingest id=abc123 size=15.2MB \nCause: upstream connect timeout`
Tariq (Infra): We saw a backend connection spike around 2024-05-12T14:10Z. Load balancer queued streams, upstream timed out. Temporary mitigation: increased backend keepalive and added 30s buffer; not a permanent fix.
Jess (CS): Proposed comms + triage plan: 1) Immediate workaround for customer: upload files as <12MB or enable client-side chunking 2) Schedule troubleshooting call today (45m) to collect payloads, SDK logs, and network traces 3) Mark account renewal status: "At risk - High" and notify renewals + finance 4) ENG PM to push a patch for stream handling, infra to assign RC. Owners: Sam = customer comms, Tariq = infra lead, Alex = support follow-ups, Jess = CS owner, Maria = AM/renewal contact.
Sam W (CS Ops): Drafting comms now, will include a short checklist and a one-click cal invite. Draft below 

Sam W (CS Ops): ```Hi PineWave team,
We're sorry you're blocked by batch ingest failures. Short-term: please split uploads so individual files are under 12MB or enable chunked uploads in the SDK. 
Can you join a troubleshooting call today at 16:30 PT? We'll capture logs and confirm a mitigation plan.
Post-call: we'll share a timeline for a permanent engineering fix.
Thanks, Sam (Redwood)
```
Maria G (AM): I'll join the call to assess renewal impact and propose a discount/extension if this materially delays pilot. Updating CRM to At risk - High. Notifying finance.
Alex (Support): Customer replied: "We can do 16:30 PT. Pilot launch scheduled in 6 business days — this blocks our ingest pipeline."
Jess (CS): Confirmed call. @SupportBot can you create incident INC-8012 and link SUP-5900? Request severity P2 and set SLA for ENG triage within 24h.
SupportBot: Incident INC-8012 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-8012  severity=P2  linked_ticket=SUP-5900 

Tariq (Infra): I'll collect pcap-level traces and enable enhanced logging for the batch parser. ETA for initial RCA: 6 hours. Working on a streaming parser patch to avoid full-buffering.
Sam W (CS Ops): Sent comms + calendar invite to PineWave, CC'd Maria and Jess. Email subject: "Redwood - Immediate workaround + troubleshooting call (PineWave)". Included checklist: SDK version, sample payload, retry headers, region, and whether they're uploading from on-prem or cloud.
Jess (CS): Good. Post-call playbook: if we can't validate fix within 48h, propose temporary credit and extend pilot window. Keep renewal flagged until CTO confirms stability. :information_source:
Alex (Support): I'll add SUP-5900 notes to CRM and paste logs ahead of the call.
Maria G (AM): I'll prepare a renewal contingency sheet for finance to review after call.
Tariq (Infra): Noted. I'll post interim updates in this thread and update INC-8012 status as we hit milestones.
Jess (CS): Thanks team  once we have post-call outcomes we will either clear the At risk flag or escalate to execs.
